name: Exp_Fast2
summary: This EA implements a dual moving average crossover strategy using the custom Fast2 indicator, which applies two smoothing algorithms with configurable methods and periods. It opens buy positions when the faster MA crosses above the slower MA and sell positions on the opposite crossover, with optional position closing on reverse signals and configurable stop-loss/take-profit levels.
summary_zh: 该EA基于自定义Fast2指标实现双均线交叉策略，使用两种可配置平滑算法和周期的移动平均线。当快速均线向上穿越慢速均线时开多仓，反之开空仓，支持反向信号平仓及可配置的止损止盈。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于双移动平均线交叉的经典趋势跟踪方法，使用Fast2自定义指标计算两条平滑线。入场条件为：当Ma1在上一根K线高于Ma2且当前K线Ma1低于Ma2时产生买入信号（即快速均线从上方穿越到下方），反之当Ma1从下方穿越到上方时产生卖出信号。出场条件包括止损和止盈的硬性设定，以及当反向交叉信号出现时可选的平仓操作。仓位管理通过MM参数控制资金比例，支持固定手数和保证金比例两种模式（LOT模式和其他MarginMode）。资金管理基于账户余额的比例计算仓位大小，配合固定点数的止损和止盈来控制单笔风险。策略使用了可配置的平滑方法（SMA、EMA、SMMA、LWMA、JJMA、JurX、ParMA、T3、VIDYA、AMA），提供了较高的灵活性。信号仅在新的K线形成时或首次加载时计算，避免了逐tick重复计算的问题。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on the classic dual moving average crossover trend-following approach, using the custom Fast2 indicator to compute two smoothed lines. Entry conditions: a buy signal is generated when Ma1 was above Ma2 on the previous bar and Ma1 falls below Ma2 on the current bar (fast MA crossing from above to below), and conversely a sell signal when Ma1 crosses from below to above. Exit conditions include hard stop-loss and take-profit levels, plus optional position closing on reverse crossover signals. Position sizing is controlled by the MM parameter which defines the money management ratio, supporting both fixed lot and margin-based lot sizing modes via the MMMode enum. Money management calculates position size as a proportion of account balance, paired with fixed pip-based stop-loss and take-profit to control per-trade risk. The strategy leverages configurable smoothing methods (SMA, EMA, SMMA, LWMA, JJMA, JurX, ParMA, T3, VIDYA, AMA) providing high flexibility. Signals are only calculated on new bar formation or on initial load, avoiding redundant per-tick recalculation.

pros: 支持10种平滑算法，策略灵活性高，可适应不同市场环境
信号仅在 新K线 时计算，减少不必要的重复计算和虚假信号
买卖开仓和平仓可独立开关控制，便于精细化策略调优
使用自定义指标句柄，指标与EA逻辑分离，结构清晰
包含Recount机制应对数据加载失败，增强了鲁棒性
pros_en: Supports 10 smoothing algorithms, offering high strategy flexibility to adapt to different market conditions
Signals are only calculated on new bar formation, reducing unnecessary recalculation and false signals
Buy/sell open and close can be independently toggled, enabling fine-grained strategy tuning
Uses custom indicator handle with separated indicator and EA logic for clean architecture
Includes Recount mechanism to handle data loading failures, enhancing robustness
cons: 均线交叉策略本质上是滞后指标，在震荡市中容易产生频繁的虚假信号导致连续亏损
没有持仓检查逻辑，可能在已有同方向持仓时重复开仓
缺少点差过滤和交易时间过滤，在恶劣交易条件下仍会入场
止损1000点和止盈2000点固定值过大，缺乏根据市场波动性动态调整的机制
没有追踪止损或移动止损功能，盈利头寸可能大幅回撤后才通过反向信号平仓
cons_en: MA crossover is inherently a lagging indicator, prone to frequent false signals and consecutive losses in ranging markets
No position check logic exists, potentially opening duplicate positions in the same direction
Lacks spread filter and trading session filter, may enter trades under adverse trading conditions
Fixed 1000-pip SL and 2000-pip TP are excessively large without dynamic adjustment based on market volatility
No trailing stop functionality, profitable positions may suffer significant drawdown before closing on reverse signal
improvements: 增加持仓检查逻辑，避免同方向重复开仓；加入ATR动态止损止盈以适应市场波动性
添加点差过滤、交易时段过滤和追踪止损功能，提升策略在不同市场条件下的适应性和风险控制能力
improvements_en: Add position check logic to avoid duplicate same-direction entries; implement ATR-based dynamic SL/TP to adapt to market volatility
Add spread filter, trading session filter, and trailing stop functionality to improve adaptability and risk control across varying market conditions

risk_points: 缺少持仓检查可能导致同方向重复开仓，造成过度敞口风险
固定的大止损值(1000点)在极端行情下可能造成单笔重大亏损
risk_points_en: Lack of position check may lead to duplicate same-direction entries, causing excessive exposure risk
Fixed large stop-loss value (1000 pips) could result in significant single-trade losses during extreme market conditions
